newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Energy Dept to kick off Elk Hills sale May 21.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Energy Dept to kick off Elk Hills sale May 21.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department is set to launch the auction of its 78 percent stake in the Elk Hills oil and natural gas field Wednesday, fossil energy spokesman Bob Porter said Tuesday.
Details of the bidding process will be unveiled in Washington at 1330 EDT/1730 GMT.
The sale of the government's interest in the Bakersfield, California field is expected to be one of the largest U.S. government divestitures ever.
According to an Energy Department estimate two years ago, the stake was worth at least $2.6 billion.
Chevron Corp owns the remaining 22 percent of the field, which is among the 11 biggest fields in the lower 48 states.
Under a 1996 law, the government must complete the sale by February 1998 as long as bids at least match independent assessments of the field's worth.
